facts.fact: A USAID Good Governance Activity workshop on 23-24 July 2024 was to standardise and assess tools for tracking revenue, registering taxpayers and budgeting for decentralised territorial entities; the activity works with 20 entities in four provinces (Haut Katanga, Lualaba, Tshopo, Haut Uele), and the entity tier is not stated.
facts.system: USAID GGA digital tools for ETDs

facts.fact: The tools for decentralised territorial entities are supported by USAID's Good Governance Activity, launched July 2023, co-hosted with the national public finance reform committee COREF.
